segments.text: O God, the king of glory, whiche haſte exalted thine only ſonne Ieſus Chriſte, with great triumphe vnto thy kingdom in heauen: we beſeche thee leaue vs not comfortles, but ſende to vs thine holy goſt to comforte vs, and exalte vs vnto theſame place, whither our ſauiour Chriſte is gone before: who lyueth and reigneth. &c.
